messages.author: 33cb3cd9a0cbc241
messages.subject: histogram counts, labels and multiplot
parts:
Is there any way to plot multiple graphics using ggplots2 for the graphics that are built in sequence but other scripts are invoked in between? grid.arrange is practical but requires all plots to be defined.

vplayout <- function(x, y) viewport(layout.pos.row = x, layout.pos.col = y)
grid.newpage()
pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(1, known.number))))

can be used but requires to know the sequence or column of the graphics

print(plot1, vp = vplayout(1, 1))

how is it possible like par() to open the device with the number of graphics to plot and like any function such as plot, plot the graphics without knowing in which position or column we're going to plot?

I want some thing like the following:
 in 1 function: par(mfrow = c(1,known.number))
 in another function: plot(p1) # will be the 1st plot at left
 in 3rd function: plot(p2) # will be the 2nd plot from left etc

 So I just know that I have known.number plots at the beginning but I don't need to pass the order of appearance or position of the plot on the device and I plot them one after the other totally independently and between plotting them other functions are invoked

Thanks

Carol
